scrollStep.tooltip: How far one notch of the scroll wheel moves brightness when the pointer is over the panel icon.

showPercent.tooltip: Display each monitor's brightness next to the panel icon.

refreshOnOpen.description: Re-read levels when the menu opens
refreshOnOpen.tooltip: Picks up changes made with the monitor's own OSD buttons or another tool. Costs about 200ms per monitor.

sleepMultiplier.tooltip: Scales the delays ddcutil leaves between i2c messages. Raise this if your monitor drops or misapplies values; lower it for snappier sliders.

advanced.tooltip: Adds contrast and colour-temperature sliders for monitors that support them. Also toggleable from the applet menu.
